assessments.reasoning: The pinned SPDX json/details/MIT.json returned the complete [0,8433) body with its registered digest. The MIT object contained separate standardLicenseTemplate, licenseText and licenseTextHtml fields. Decoding standardLicenseTemplate preserved the matching directives, backslashes and trailing line feeds used in the comparison.

The pinned SPDX template/MIT.template.txt returned HTTP 200. Its entire [0,1958) body matched the registered template digest and the decoded standardLicenseTemplate field, including both terminal line feeds.
The complete [0,1078) body of text/MIT.txt at the same commit matched its registered digest. Direct comparison found it unequal to the template, with a difference at the first byte.

The complete SPDX repository tag response for object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b matched the cited [0,700) range and SHA-256 9695bf0c0fae8f1db7f1bee44d2176c06a045a3fb62f1ab9aa4b4cef283ebd13. It named v3.29.0 and identified the target as a commit whose SHA matched the exact matcher, detail and plain URLs.

challenge.method: Remove one trailing line feed from an in-memory template copy and repeat the field comparison. Test the plain representation against standardLicenseTemplate. Check the exact tag binding and repeat with a different tag name, target type and target SHA.
challenge.results: Removing one line feed defeated template equality. The plain text also failed equality with standardLicenseTemplate. The observed annotation matched all three URLs. Each independent change to its name, target type or target SHA defeated release attribution while leaving the original byte comparisons intact.

limitations: The finding covers the complete pinned template, its decoded JSON field and the pinned plain-text comparator without normalization. It establishes no matching outcome for another text, license applicability or redistribution rights.

The immutable JavaScript compared the bodies directly and reported acquisition-supplied SHA-256 values. The release mapping rests on an unsigned annotation from the SPDX repository API. The policy bundle was identified by the supplied digest without independently acquiring its bytes.
reasoning: The supplied immutable JavaScript method returned matcher_equals_detail_field=true and matcher_differs_from_plain=true. The complete ASCII template and decoded standardLicenseTemplate therefore have identical UTF-8 bytes. The template acquisition reported 1,958 bytes and SHA-256 9b91e12dfe57d42e91ea96d2acb7624040bffc54182bd164d39d0fae33e77794. The template begins with <<beginOptional>> and ends with two line feeds. The 1,078-byte generated plain text begins with MIT License and ends with one line feed. The independently acquired v3.29.0 annotation targets commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 in all three representation URLs.
